name: Kasumi
source: The youngest of Choujirou’s discuples, Kasumi is treated as the little sister of the group. She adores the protagonist and looks up to her, calling her “Sis”. Her skills as a shinobi are weak, but she is good at cooking and sewing.
translation: The youngest of Choujirou’s discuples, Kasumi is treated as the little sister of the group. She adores the protagonist and looks up to her, calling her “Sis”. Her skills as a shinobi are weak, but she is good at cooking and sewing.
